blogs.title: Why Aligning Language Models Matters — From Unlimited Knowledge to Safe Assistants
blogs.description: An introductory look at why massive unsupervised LMs need extra steering via human feedback, explaining the gap between raw knowledge and controllable behavior.

blogs.title: The Hidden Costs of Traditional RLHF — Unpacking Supervised Fine‑Tuning, Reward Modeling, and Reinforcement Learning
blogs.description: A deep dive into the three‑stage RLHF pipeline, highlighting why fitting separate reward models and running PPO can become unstable and compute‑heavy.

blogs.title: Secretly a Reward Model: How Direct Preference Optimization Turns Preferences Into a Simple Classification Task
blogs.description: Explains the key mathematical trick behind DPO—reparameterizing rewards as policy‑to‑reference log‑ratios—so that learning reduces to binary cross‑entropy.

blogs.title: One Loss to Rule Them All: A Practical Step‑by‑Step Guide to Fine‑Tuning LLMs with Direct Preference Optimization
blogs.description: Walks through the complete DPO workflow—from gathering preference pairs through setting β and reference models—to training with a single loss function.

blogs.title: When Simplicity Wins: Empirical Evidence That DPO Beats PPO‑Based RLHF
blogs.description: Summarizes experimental results showing DPO’s superior reward–KL trade‑off, higher win rates on summarisation/dialogue tasks, and greater stability across temperatures.

blogs.title: Beyond the Paper – Real‑World Uses of Direct Preference Optimization and What’s Next for Alignment Research
blogs.description: Shows how DPO was applied to sentiment control, Reddit TL;DR summarisation and safer chatbots, discusses current limitations and future directions like scaling and multimodal alignment.
